---
name: A game does not work
about: A game fails to launch, crashes, or renders incorrectly
labels: game-report
---

**Paste the output of `decanter report <game>`.** It is copied to your clipboard
automatically and contains everything below — the machine, the runtime and
backend actually in use, the DXVK build actually installed, font mapping status,
detection evidence, and the graphics-related log lines.

Please rename or redact the game if you would rather not name it; the report is
still useful without the title.

```
<paste here>
```

**What happens:** <crash on launch / black screen / blank text / renders wrong / hangs>

**Did you already try `decanter recommend <game> --apply`?**
It applies the configuration most likely to work without launching anything, and
it resolves a surprising share of reports.

**Screenshot**, if the fault is visual — Command-Shift-4, Space, click the
window. Decanter does not capture the screen itself.
